symptom: On a customer page, clicking the Recent orders tab blanks the whole page (name, Edit button and tabs disappear) and shows a spinner until the orders arrive, instead of only loading the tab panel.

truth.cause: CustomerOrdersPanel suspends with useSuspenseQuery, and CustomerDetailPage renders it without its own Suspense boundary. The nearest boundary is the route match's, above the page, so a plain (non-transition) tab switch hides the entire page behind the fallback.

referenceFix.replace:
import { Button } from '../../components/ui/button'
import { Skeleton } from '../../components/ui/feedback'
